event.description:
Another Set championship for Grand Archive!Entry fee: $20Player cap: 32  

Event structure:  5 Rounds swiss, Bo3 + standard overtime (NO TOP CUT) 
Event schedule: Check in 10:00AM - 10:50AM / Round 1 Start: 11:00 AM 

THIS EVENT IS CAPPED AT 32 PLAYERS!

PRIZING

1ST - 1 National Qualifier Card (Nullyfying MIrror CPR), 1 Champion Playmat, 8 Booster Packs, 4 Event Packs

2ND - 6 PTM Booster Packs, 3 Event Packs

3RD - 4 PTM Booster Packs, 2 Event Packs

4TH - 4 PTM Booster Packs, 1 Event Pack

5TH - 8TH 2 PTM Booster Packs, 1 Event Pack

**Note that top 8 Prizing may change from RDO to AMB packs based on attendance

This store champs we will have store credit per win!

Registration: In person / call the store / dm the store discord account to reserve a spot, we will need your full name phone number, AND OMNIDEX ID number. 

Tournament run by Kani / Judging by Ken

⚠️ PLEASE NOTE ⚠️
RSVPING to the omni event does NOT count as registering. You may register for the event IN STORE or by CALLING (650) 362-3008. Staff have been asked to record players to the registrant list upon payment. Please make sure your OMNI ID#, first name and last name are logged during the registration process to help us ensure an accurate player count. Join our discord to talk to the community at https://discord.gg/VSXnYyQRa2
